note: Each threshold the template's rules hold to, with the sites it was measured on (from the code's own comments; [] where none is recorded). scripts/test/thresholds.test.mjs checks every value against the code. A threshold measured on fewer than two sites is listed in each site's layout plan (layout-plan.md) for review on a new site.

thresholds.what: share of our side of a review's side-by-side shots that may differ (channel difference over 24) from the shots the review judged, with the same measures, for the review to stand
thresholds.source: owner 2026-11-17, site13's 40-minute run; replay of Strandmill's 525 review pairs 2026-11-14 to 11-17: no P0/P1 change within 0.5% (45 pairs), the first at 0.82%

thresholds.what: how much wider than its average a title set in capitals wraps
thresholds.source: the motel site's phone titles: 1.12 kept its five ten-word capital titles within four phone lines

thresholds.what: share of the competitor page a layout the template lacks takes before the run holds for a decision
thresholds.source: 15% of the motel competitor's home is about the 1,000px window the review looks through

thresholds.what: sections of a hub repeating its child pages before it goes back to Site Factory
thresholds.source: owner 2026-11-12, the motel site's /services/

thresholds.what: slack around the competitor's density range
thresholds.source: not recorded

thresholds.what: bytes a phone crop of a photo may weigh (never more than its desktop file either)

thresholds.what: words of what a photo to be made shows that its page's H1 and copy (a section's brief: the H1 and its section) must share, config/photo-text-check.json's stop words left out; fewer and the photo is held out of the queue and reported (check-photo-text.mjs)
thresholds.source: owner 2026-11-17 via Site Factory (a photo's subject checked against its page's H1 and copy by code before it is made); tried on site12's and site13's plans 2026-11-17

thresholds.what: photos of each photo class made and passed by the image-fit judge before the rest of the library is made (generate-images.mjs --samples, judge-image-fit.mjs --samples)

thresholds.what: bytes a published photo file may weigh, its 1536-wide size included: encoded a quality step lower, then narrower, until within (render-web-images.mjs --over-budget, in the images step, encodes again the files published before it)

thresholds.what: images a page fetches with fetchpriority=high

thresholds.what: milliseconds of the throttled phone LCP over which the layout audit fails the page (lcp_slow)

thresholds.what: the network and CPU the phone LCP is measured under (Chrome DevTools Protocol)

thresholds.what: the phone screen the LCP is measured on
thresholds.source: Lighthouse core/config/constants.js screenEmulationMetrics.mobile (Moto G Power 2022)

thresholds.what: axe impacts of the 33 agent-tree rules that fail a page (agent_tree); moderate and minor are reported (agent_tree_minor)

thresholds.what: CSS pixels of a focused control the phone's enquiry bar may cover (rounding) before enquiry_bar_covers fails

thresholds.what: controls of a page checked against the enquiry bar: a bound on the work, not a measure

thresholds.what: indexable pages one site-wide hero photo opens at most: the image plan asks for heroes enough, the SEO audit reports one on more (hero_reused)

thresholds.what: indexable pages one site-wide factory or process photo (REUSE_CAPPED_KINDS) shows on at most: the image plan asks for photos enough, the SEO audit reports one on more (process_reused)
thresholds.source: four-site audit 2026-11-17, Fable's plan C13: site13's three process photos (general-process-1 to 3) on 11 pages each; the same cap as HERO_MAX_PAGES

thresholds.what: words of the one sentence a claude-seo audit finding quotes from the Google rules library at most (findings.json evidence kind google-rules)
thresholds.source: owner 2026-11-17, the brief of Strandmill's hand-run audit: 一句原文（不超过 15 个词）

thresholds.what: characters of a claude-seo audit finding's location (the text or markup copied from the page) at most
thresholds.source: the evidence rule of the audit it replaced (config/agent-steps/seo-audit.md, four-site audit 2026-11-17): a short quote copied exactly, at most 200 characters

thresholds.what: characters running two auditors' locations on one page must share (or the shorter lies whole in the other) for their findings to be one problem, with SEO_AUDIT_MERGE_PROBLEM_SIMILARITY
thresholds.source: owner 2026-11-17 ("可以 而且可以并行不是吗": three auditors, findings merged by place and problem); site13's hand-run seo-audit-3 against seo-audit-4: the same problems quoted the same passage, the passage alone also matched different problems on the home H1

thresholds.what: how alike two auditors' problems on one page and passage must be (Dice coefficient of letter and digit bigrams) to be merged; anything less stays two findings
thresholds.source: owner 2026-11-17 (拿不准的不合并); site13's seo-audit-3 against seo-audit-4, 110 pairs on the same page: the same problem in other words 0.35 and 0.46, different problems on a shared location 0.01 to 0.23

thresholds.what: pages of the claude-seo audit measured on a desktop screen and a throttled phone, with screenshots
